images.after: Five things a model can't supply for you
images.title: Five things a model can't supply
images.alt: Five cards: first-hand experience with evidence, a specific point of view, original data or a tool, a direct reader relationship, and a trusted name.
images.caption: Each of these comes from you, which is why a rewrite of existing pages can't contain them.

items.title: First-hand experience
items.text: Your screenshots, settings, dates, numbers and mistakes as evidence

items.title: A specific point of view
items.text: A recommendation and the reasoning, not a balanced list

items.title: Original data or a tool
items.text: A comparison you checked, a small survey, a calculator or a template

items.title: A direct relationship
items.text: An email list or community of people who asked to hear from you

items.title: A name people trust
items.text: A real byline, an honest about page and corrections when you're wrong

images.after: A checklist: what did you add that a model couldn't have written?
images.title: Run this before you publish
images.alt: Checklist of seven questions to ask about a draft, from first-hand observations and a clear recommendation to checked facts and a named author.
images.caption: If the answer to the first five is no, the page is a summary. Add what's missing rather than inventing it.

items: Something you observed yourself: a result, screenshot or problem
The page says how you know
A clear recommendation, and who it's wrong for
Something that didn't work, or a limit of your own test
Every specific fact checked against a linked primary source
Readers know who wrote it and how to reach you

images.after: Where AI helps, and where it will hurt you
images.title: Where AI helps and where it hurts
images.alt: Comparison of writing tasks AI is useful for, like outlining and tightening sentences, against what it is unreliable for, like facts and experience.
images.caption: Use AI for the parts of writing that aren't your contribution, and verify every specific claim it produces.

columns.label: Useful for
points: Turning rough notes into an outline
Pointing out gaps in a draft
Suggesting headings or reformatting a table

columns.label: Unreliable for
points: Statistics, quotes, prices and policy details
Hundreds of pages from a template
